status: pre-registered technical research run; results pending
protocol_hash_basis: SHA-256 of this canonical JSON, source hashes and environment manifest stored in each run record
pilot_seed_exclusion: integer seeds 0 through 23 are excluded because they were used by the morphology-only pilot
initial_computational_genomes: fresh registered v4 initial-state generator, one independent seed per paired block; all three arms start from the same seed and compute state
primary_outcome: per-replicate time average of unique active phenotype count across recorded genuine population births; summarized per arm and paired within seed
stop_rule: Stop after the first completed transition at which any registered ceiling is reached; retain that transition and report bounded overshoot. No results are dropped for extinction, no births or low diversity.
comparison: paired seeds and byte-identical compute trajectories are required; show all seed-level results, paired differences, mean/median and a two-sided exact sign/permutation summary; exploratory sample only, not a production-efficacy claim
retention: per-transition compressed rows and state hashes in one SQLite database; no genotype resurrection; no discarded scientific row without a hash-chain record
prohibited_inference: Morphology novelty, phenotype count or niche occupancy is not a prediction capability. Any computational capability requires independent held-out confirmation.
